title: Dread Warren round 4: improves and the caves again, webs only in danger
desc: J, coordinator 3's menu: "IMPROVEs + caves". Three new versions of each v2.0108 IMPROVE (Broodling mane, Phantom wire, Lights out: the scream and the shell opens, the deep funnel hollow; the Matron takes are skipped because the spider lair cuts her, so Lights out now stars the lair's yellow construct spider), and the v2.0106 caves again: disguised, appealing entrances ("the entrances are too obvious or unappealing"), the Weave Gallery, and the Hatchery lit so its shape reads. Every cave is a CALM / DANGER pair: "I would prefer you only see the webs once youre in danger". No columns; creatures turn; ceiling walking still on hold.

takes.name: Entrance: the hollow oak
takes.facts: from W1a ("the entrances are too obvious or unappealing"): a huge old oak still in leaf; the way in is a warm-lit arch between its roots, the shaft runs down its hollow heart to a den. Calm it looks like a shelter; danger: silk across the arch and up the trunk, eyes down the shaft, a Hunter rearing by the roots; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); both turn
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a1 Entrance: the hollow oak

takes.name: Entrance: the old well
takes.facts: from W1a ("the entrances are too obvious or unappealing"): an old overgrown well with a little wooden roof, mossy stones and flowers round it, a gold glint far down (the lure). Calm it is just a well; danger: a web lid over the mouth, silk ladders down the shaft, eyes on the walls, a Hunter beside it; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); both turn
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a2 Entrance: the old well

takes.name: Entrance: the lit cleft
takes.facts: from W1a ("the entrances are too obvious or unappealing"): a mossy hillside with a narrow cleft behind a curtain of hanging leaves, glowing warm inside like a lit lantern. Calm it looks like a cosy hollow; danger: the vines turn out to be silk, a web across the cleft, eyes inside, a Hunter at the door; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); both turn
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a3 Entrance: the lit cleft

takes.name: Weave Gallery: ribbed nave
takes.facts: from W1b: a straight nave 7 wide and 12 tall, its vault held by spider-made ribs arching overhead every 4 blocks (no columns; the ceiling between the ribs is cut away so you can see in); burrows in both walls. Danger: the webs between the ribs light up like stained glass, a Hunter drops on its thread over you; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); cut open at the front like a doll's house
takes.cam3p: Cam W1b1 Weave Gallery: ribbed nave

takes.name: Weave Gallery: winding nave
takes.facts: from W1b: the nave winds in an S so you never see far ahead, the ribs follow the bends, burrows in the walls. Danger: webs light across the bends, Hunters in the burrows, one drops on you; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); cut open at the front like a doll's house
takes.cam3p: Cam W1b2 Weave Gallery: winding nave

takes.name: Weave Gallery: balconies
takes.facts: from W1b: a wider nave with two tiers of balconies carved along the walls, five burrows on each balcony. Danger: threads strung balcony to balcony, webs between the ribs, Hunters on the balconies, one drops on you; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); cut open at the front like a doll's house
takes.cam3p: Cam W1b3 Weave Gallery: balconies

takes.name: Hatchery: lit by the sacs
takes.facts: from W1c (the egg sacs glow nicely, the room was too dark to read): a low dome with two rows of egg niches all round its wall (28 sacs); every sac has its own soft light and a warm bounce off the floor shows the dome's curve. Danger: the sacs crack and burst, silk strung niche to niche, broodlings on the floor; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); cut open at the front like a doll's house
takes.cam3p: Cam W1c1 Hatchery: lit by the sacs

takes.name: Hatchery: vein-traced dome
takes.facts: from W1c (the egg sacs glow nicely, the room was too dark to read): the same dome traced in glowing gold veins: a rim round every niche and ribs running up from the floor, so the honeycomb's shape reads even far off. Danger: sacs crack, webs, broodlings out; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); cut open at the front like a doll's house
takes.cam3p: Cam W1c2 Hatchery: vein-traced dome

takes.name: Hatchery: fear-light pools
takes.facts: from W1c (the egg sacs glow nicely, the room was too dark to read): shallow pools of yellow fear-light on the floor light the honeycomb from below, five pools spread round the dome. Danger: sacs crack, webs over the room, broodlings out; left CALM (webs hidden, nothing out), right DANGER (webs lit, spiders out); cut open at the front like a doll's house
takes.cam3p: Cam W1c3 Hatchery: fear-light pools

takes.name: Broodlings: mane, thick collar
takes.facts: from W2a3c; a dense short collar of spines round the waist, like a ruff; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back
takes.cam3p: Cam W2a3c1 Broodlings: mane, thick collar

takes.name: Broodlings: mane, swept back
takes.facts: from W2a3c; a dozen long spines swept back over the abdomen like a crest; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back
takes.cam3p: Cam W2a3c2 Broodlings: mane, swept back

takes.name: Broodlings: mane, gold tips
takes.facts: from W2a3c; the same mane with polished-gold tips and a dimmed body, so the ring of tips reads; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back
takes.cam3p: Cam W2a3c3 Broodlings: mane, gold tips

takes.name: Lights out: scream, floor shockwave
takes.facts: from W3c1a; the lair's yellow construct spider screams (the Matron is cut): rings of static from its head and the same rings rolling out across the floor; eyes in every burrow
takes.cam3p: Cam W3c1a1 Lights out: scream, floor shockwave

takes.name: Lights out: scream, broken rings

takes.cam3p: Cam W3c1a2 Lights out: scream, broken rings

takes.name: Lights out: scream, cone of static
